source.repro: In ~/src/jb2plugins/jbrowse-plugin-msaview at 3.10.0 against @jbrowse/core 5.0.0-beta.9, run its esbuild config four ways and gzip -9 the result: as configured; with the host floor set to the installed ReExports/list rather than scripts/host-reexports-floor.json; that plus format esm and splitting true; and that plus react-msaview held out with `external`. For the split builds the figure is the ENTRY plus its static-import closure, since that is what a host evaluates before the view is opened.
source.notes: One plugin, chosen because it is the largest in the store and its source already writes lazy(). The last row holds react-msaview out entirely, so it is a bound on deferral rather than a build anyone would ship — a real split leaves it as a chunk the view still fetches when opened.

values.build: host floor raised to the v5 list
